topics.title: Business finance, financial management and its objective
topics.ncert_sections: Meaning of Business Finance; Financial Management; Importance; Objectives

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the meaning of business finance and why it is needed at every stage of a business.
Describe financial management and how its decisions shape the financial statements of a business.
Explain wealth maximisation as the primary objective of financial management.

topics.title: Investment decision (capital budgeting)
topics.ncert_sections: Investment Decision; Factors affecting Capital Budgeting Decision

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish long-term (capital budgeting) and short-term (working capital) investment decisions.
Explain the factors affecting capital budgeting decisions: cash flows, rate of return and investment criteria.

topics.title: Financing decision
topics.ncert_sections: Financing Decision; Factors Affecting Financing Decisions

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the financing decision, financial risk and floatation cost of different sources of funds.
Apply the factors affecting financing decisions to business situations.

topics.title: Dividend decision
topics.ncert_sections: Dividend Decision; Factors Affecting Dividend Decision

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the dividend decision as the split of profit between dividend and retained earnings.
Apply the factors affecting dividend decisions to business situations.
State the meaning, process and twin objectives of financial planning.
Explain the importance of financial planning and how it differs from financial management.

topics.title: Capital structure and trading on equity
topics.ncert_sections: Capital Structure; EBIT-EPS analysis; Trading on Equity

concepts.learning_objective: Explain capital structure, debt-equity ratio, financial leverage and the risk of debt.
Use EBIT-EPS analysis to judge when trading on equity raises EPS.

topics.title: Factors affecting the choice of capital structure
topics.ncert_sections: Factors affecting the Choice of Capital Structure

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate and interpret the interest coverage ratio and debt service coverage ratio.
Apply factors such as tax rate, cost of equity, risk, control and market conditions to capital structure choices.

topics.title: Fixed and working capital
topics.ncert_sections: Fixed and Working Capital: Meaning; Management of Fixed Capital; Working Capital; Factors

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the management of fixed capital and the factors affecting its requirement.
Analyse the factors affecting the working capital requirement of a business.
Define current assets, current liabilities and net working capital.
